findings.title: Wait for the reader to finish before checking its exceptions
findings.body: Setting deletedAll does not wait for an in-flight groups request to complete. The assertion can run while the reader is still awaiting a response, so a failure from the concurrent deletion can be added to caughtExceptions after the test has already passed. Retain the reader thread and join it before asserting. Stop and join it in a finally block as well: if a deletion throws, the current code never sets deletedAll and leaves a non-daemon thread continuously issuing requests into subsequent tests.
